# British Association for Music Therapy

> BAMT is the UK's professional body for music therapists, providing membership, professional standards, clinical services, and advocacy for music therapy as an evidence-based allied health profession.

The British Association for Music Therapy (BAMT) represents qualified music therapists across the UK and promotes music therapy in healthcare, education, and social care settings. BAMT was formed in 2011 through the merger of the Association of Professional Music Therapists (APMT) and the British Society for Music Therapy (BSMT).

## About Music Therapy

- [What is Music Therapy?](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy/what-is-music-therapy): Definition and clinical applications of music therapy across conditions
- [What is a Music Therapist?](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy/what-is-a-music-therapist): Music therapist qualifications, HCPC registration, and professional standards
- [Music Therapy Overview](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy): Overview of music therapy, practitioners, and UK services
- [Music Therapy in the UK](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy/music-therapy-in-the-uk): Music therapy services, clinical settings, and therapist finder in UK
- [Allied Health Professions](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy/allied-health-professions): Overview of music therapy within allied health professions and NHS roles
- [Music Therapy Media](https://www.bamt.org/music-therapy/music-therapy-media): Video resources, patient stories, and training materials on music therapy
